prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this four-object transparent sprite atlas solely to fix production sprite packing. Preserve the EXACT same four object designs/materials/colors/details and their frontal viewpoint. Reduce the size of EACH of the four objects by about20percent and reposition each entirely in its OWN quadrant of a2x2 square canvas. TOP LEFT vestibule, TOP RIGHT sensor post, BOTTOM LEFT low security terminal, BOTTOM RIGHT low rock/conduit border. Keep ALL silhouettes complete, including the far left foot of the security terminal: it must not touch the canvas edge. Minimum60pixels FULLY TRANSPARENT margin to all canvas borders, and a very wide empty transparent cross between the four objects. No overlap or continuation across cell boundaries. Do not add a background, shadows outside their cell, text, gridlines, any object, or animation pose. Native alpha remains genuinely transparent. No scenery modifications besides fitting the complete unchanged objects inside separated cells.

Use case: stylized-concept. Native transparent STATIC modular object atlas for the original Yautja 'Porte de l’Audience' 2D fighting stage. Reference1 is material/light guide only. Exactly four complete separate objects, strict2x2 layout square1536x1536,40px transparent margin per object and wide clear cross gap. Fixed frontal side-stage view with shallow top surfaces, not rotated isometry. No connected scene, no terrain plane. No people, statues, masks, gods, magic, flames, glyph words, labels, UI or gridlines.
TOP LEFT P1: one small distant closed alien access vestibule, squat broad dark alloy double airlock recessed into a chunky natural basalt shell with a horizontal layered canopy. Warm small amber doorjamb slots, curved reinforcing ribs, grounded foundation. No steps or ceremonial staircase. Complete silhouette.
TOP RIGHT P2: one tall practical access-control structural post, blackened bronze ribs wrap a stone core, two recessed sensor apertures and a protected cable duct leading to a solid foot; no humanoid robot shape, no weapon, no torch.
BOTTOM LEFT P3: one low waist-height security terminal with a broad sloping heavy metal face, small recessed amber access display, thick protective curved side panels and a wide grounded stone base. No aerial hologram or writing. Compact enough to remain below a fighter's waist when scaled.
BOTTOM RIGHT P5: one low layered rock retaining-edge fragment with a bolted dark metal conduit cover and a short embedded amber marker. No isolated shards or separate ground shadow rectangle.
Polished realistic hand-painted game sprite material: dry pale charcoal/brown basalt, worn bronze alloy, soft late-afternoon illumination upperleft. Convey sophisticated alien engineering through shaped ribs, protected conduits and controlled amber recesses, not generic medieval fantasy ornament. Four independent native-alpha drawings with generous separation. No combat floor and no animation sequence.
